items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending. Left after 5-150-1 first half.
items.why: Same hamstring as camp issue but sources say minor; could play Week 2 vs Saints.
items.implication: Monitor practice; high upside if active, have backup ready.

items.text: Malik Nabers in first game since ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (team-high 31% share), 6-69-0 and emerged healthy.
items.why: Late game-time decision after full practices; family not present due to uncertainty.
items.implication: Viable WR2/flex with high target share despite limited snaps; monitor ramp-up.
items.opportunity: 71% routes and 31% targets on limited snaps signal expanded role ahead.

items.text: AJ Brown high-ankle sprain more serious; expected 6 weeks, no surgery, placed on IR (min 4).
items.why: MRI confirmed; typical 4-6 but this on longer end.
items.implication: NE WR room thinned; look to Hollins/Doubs/Douglas for volume.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest/ribs) undergoing further testing after big hit; exited third quarter after 5-82-1. May miss time.
items.why: Thunderous hit over middle; classified chest then ribs.
items.implication: Significant risk for Week 2; slot role could open for others if out.

items.text: Ravens rookie Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist, out several weeks.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth hit with Flowers also dinged; opens snaps for others.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) out as expected; surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson, routes 24/5/7, opps 18/9/4.
items.why: MCL sprain; full practice late week but not ready.
items.implication: Etienne lead but committee persists; Miller handcuff/value.
items.opportunity: Etienne  high routes/opps but shared; reverse full-dominate assumption.
items.conflict: Pre-game expectation of Etienne dominate vs actual split.

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers everywhere despite decoy risk after late ACTIVE.
After meniscus trim Tuesday, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 at LAC.
items.why: Team monitoring how he feels this week; walking unaided postgame.
items.implication: Hold; Mayer fills short-term but Bowers TE1 ASAP if back.

items.text: Former No. 4 pick Marvin Harrison has zero career games with 8+ catches. Kendrick Bourne in ARZ debut went 8-75-0.
items.why: Historical lack of high-catch games persists.
items.implication: Ceiling capped on receptions; boom via yards/TDs more than volume.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid finally over PCL: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
items.implication: TE1 upside unlocked with high snap/route share.

items.text: Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps; Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks worked off side early week (groin tweak alleged).
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead; Brooks change-of-pace only for now.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
items.why: Strong Week 1 production in Ravens offense.
items.implication: TE streamer/breakout candidate with Andrews healthy or not.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland. Preseason wanted as much Bears offense as possible; that hasn't changed despite Week 1.
items.why: Week 1 target competition with Kmet/Raymond but long-term Bears TE upside.
items.implication: Hold/buy; volume should come in high-powered offense.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason talk (new OC Mannion from Packers).
